_about: AcciMap level placement (Phase 6 P6-7). Rasmussen's levels run from 1 (government) to 6 (work and equipment). Entities are tried first, then the HFACS level. A --map file may add 'keywords' (level -> regexes matched against a finding's roles and label), and may replace 'entities', 'hfacs_levels' or 'subcategories' entries. Placements at levels 1 to 3 are inferred.
